question: What share of community district BK15 was inside the area Sandy flooded?

plan.rationale: The query asks about the proportion of Community District BK15 that experienced flooding during Hurricane Sandy, requiring a neighborhood-level analysis.

claims.text: 38.5% of this area lies inside the 2012 Hurricane Sandy inundation extent (area 11.67 km²).
23.1% of this area is modeled to flood under DEP Extreme Stormwater (3.66 in/hr, 2080 SLR).
1.8% of this area is modeled to flood under DEP Moderate Stormwater (2.13 in/hr, 2050 SLR).
0.7% of this area is modeled to flood under DEP Moderate Stormwater (2.13 in/hr, current SLR).
49.4% of the area sits less than 1 m above the nearest drainage (HAND).
Experimental: Policy passages retrieved from the NYC flood-policy corpus for this place: 3.
1530 NYC 311 flood-related complaints were filed inside this area in the last 3 years.
60 active NYC DOB construction permits inside this area since 2025-04-04: 22 inside the 2012 Sandy extent and 24 inside at least one DEP stormwater scenario.
This stretch of 4 Avenue Brooklyn is served by five stations that have been impacted by heavy rainfall and is prone to chronic flooding.

Flood Resilience at NYCHA includes sites such as ASTORIA BARUCH BEACH 41ST STREET, CAMPOS PLAZA II, CAREY GARDENS, CARLTON MANOR, CONEY ISLAND (SITE 8), CONEY ISLAND HOUSES, CONEY ISLAND IB, CONEY ISLAND 4&5, EAST RIVER GOWANUS, GRAVESEND HABER HAMMEL, ISAACS, LA GUARDIA, LAVANBURG HOMES, LINCOLN HO.
